bull_argument.argument:
Frontken combines high operating margins, very low gross debt and FCF roughly matching profit. In-line H1 core results and reported advanced-node demand support a business-quality argument grounded in semiconductor maintenance economics.

At 43.91x trailing earnings, the purchase thesis requires later-quarter delivery and durable fab utilization. An oversold pullback above the long-term average may eventually improve execution, but a confirmed base is needed; low leverage makes this a more credible patient-growth case than balance-sheet speculation. Statement periods and forward estimates remain undated, so conviction is conditional.

bear_argument.argument:
43.91x trailing and 35.57x forward earnings leave little margin for cycle disappointment. Strong cash conversion and low debt do not resolve the 56.78x market-cap/profit discrepancy or verify anticipated later-quarter strength.

Oversold pullback is pressing a repeated 4.78 low and the lower Bollinger band; holding above SMA200 is not enough to confirm a turn. The price evidence does not independently establish an attractive immediate allocation. The bull case is conditional on further operating or financial confirmation; those conditions should gate new capital rather than be treated as facts already proved.

A premium multiple exposes shareholders to semiconductor spending-cycle disappointments.
